name: California black oak
desc: California black oak (Quercus kelloggii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 135 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Quercus kelloggii, the California black oak or Kellogg oak, is an oak in the red oak section (genus Quercus, section Lobatae, series Agrifoliae) native to western North America.
